name: Scissors and Pink Angels
source:
Eyz is nothing more than an ordinary middle schooler who’s not quite sure which path to follow after graduation. However, after getting closer to one of his new classmates, Kyles — a boy for whom he ends up developing vague and confusing feelings — the normality of his generic teenage day-to-day routine is completely shattered.
In this way, Eyz's life turns into a disgustingly bloody and chaotic tale about monstrous beings and those who carry an important duty to fulfill for humanity.

Note:
This game was made as a parody and fanfic. Eyz and Kyles are based on two real people — YouTubers and illustrators of the same name. To better understand this work, watching this video is recommended: https://youtu.be/xNMe3O3wsFc?si=A0cJ03SohuxcmHNQ
